description: Every storage edit or SQL mutation this server sent or refused (newest last, at most 1000), WITHOUT values or SQL text: time, opId, device, app, prefs file / database, table, key or column (credential-looking names as [redacted-name]), primary key digest, op, code, phase, late, persisted, changes. A late:true entry is a final answer that came after its write timed out: use it (by opId) to learn whether a timed-out edit was applied. Needs enabled Storage read permission (on by default).
name: get_storage_audit
title: Storage edit audit
